timing_authority.rule: A cut may occur only at a mapped causal turn. Within one plate, use authored parallax, depth movement, or local evidence reveals; never insert an artificial same-plate cut.

global_edit_rules: Raster plates carry only atmosphere, action, and bounded visual metaphors. All factual text, sources, numbers, and qualifiers are local deterministic layers.
Each plate enters on the decisive noun or causal verb that makes it relevant, gains at least one narrative-native movement, and exits only when the narrator changes economic mechanism.
A reused plate is permitted only for an explicit callback or a new constrained continuation named below. No decorative montage, random asset rotation, or unmatched finance iconography.
Use the lower caption band; never cover a decision actor, money-flow path, input gate, or evidence card.

composition_groups.edit_instruction: Preserve the approved first-90-second proof sequencing. Treat the two-elevator cutaway as a diagnosis, not background wallpaper.

composition_groups.entry: Return below the two elevators when the narration asks the causal questions.
composition_groups.motion: Reveal one physical support cable per named memory support; countercut once to the index allocation container only when automatic flows are named.
composition_groups.exit: Zoom into the memory elevator's technical foundation on the word introducing HBM.

composition_groups.entry: Expose stacked working memory beside the accelerator as HBM is named.
composition_groups.motion: Short data-path lights travel between distinct stack layers and the adjacent accelerator; local anchor points to placement only.
composition_groups.exit: Follow the data path into the narrow channel on the engine analogy.

composition_groups.entry: Cut as the engine/fuel analogy begins.
composition_groups.motion: Queue units accumulate at the visibly narrow memory channel, then a second generic accelerator resolves to the same gate; do not depict literal fuel.
composition_groups.exit: Pan downstream to physical production inputs when the shortage is made physical.

composition_groups.entry: Reveal a distinct physical input on each named constraint.
composition_groups.motion: Inputs converge one at a time on the output gate; the gate narrows visually but does not permanently close.
composition_groups.exit: Match-cut the constrained gate into the bakery oven door.

composition_groups.entry: Open on the bakery analogy; no source card yet.
composition_groups.motion: Simple loaves slide aside as layered cakes consume a fixed oven schedule; use physical capacity allocation, not a price-line metaphor.
composition_groups.exit: Dissolve cake layers into HBM stack layers at the return to the actual production system.

composition_groups.entry: Return from the analogy only as shared advanced capacity is spoken.
composition_groups.motion: Continue the physical inputs to the output gate, then reveal the source rail after the reported capacity trade is named.
composition_groups.exit: Separate the production corridor into a repeated commodity cycle versus commitment rail.

composition_groups.entry: Split the frame when the classic cycle is introduced.
composition_groups.motion: Let the left lane repeat boom-to-supply-to-price pressure while the right lane exposes the agreement structure only when reported buyer behavior is named.
composition_groups.exit: Track the agreement rail forward into reservations; retain the cycle on screen through the caveat.

composition_groups.entry: Open the reservation rail on reported commitments, then reveal the evidence card after its scope is spoken.
composition_groups.motion: Buyer tokens reserve capacity ahead of production; hold the guidance caveat at the evidence layer rather than converting it into a forecast image.
composition_groups.exit: Pull out along the rail as the narration widens from memory to strategic production.

composition_groups.entry: Expand the reservation rail into the network when strategic chokepoints are named.
composition_groups.motion: Light one production node per named domain; keep the network descriptive, not geopolitical prediction.
composition_groups.exit: Settle on the regional market stage before any comparative figure appears.

composition_groups.entry: Enter the neutral market stage before the narrow public-equity comparison is made.
composition_groups.motion: Open the deterministic market card only after the listed-market scope and date are spoken.
composition_groups.exit: Keep the stage while the narration corrects the reductive comparison.
composition_groups.reuse_reason: Evidence card requires this specific public-market scope.

composition_groups.entry: Hold the market-stage causal lens through the correction, not through a caricature of either country.
composition_groups.motion: Capital flow resolves into distinct industrial cash-flow layers; clear the comparative card before the broader strategic conclusion.
composition_groups.exit: Pull one capital-flow strand into the strategic network.
composition_groups.reuse_reason: Continuing the question of what public markets price.

composition_groups.entry: Return to strategic-production nodes on the cautious macro claim.
composition_groups.motion: Reveal the dated context card after technology intensity and semiconductor export context are named.
composition_groups.exit: Route the compute node into a memory reservoir.

composition_groups.entry: Show compute machinery constrained by its memory reservoir.
composition_groups.motion: A compute pipeline pauses only while its reservoir starves; then resume to preserve the qualified-system, not-magic claim.
composition_groups.exit: The reservoir's frame becomes the index elevator frame at the fair S&P introduction.

composition_groups.entry: Open the index elevator on its low-cost, liquid, tax-efficient job before introducing critique.
composition_groups.motion: Automatic cash streams sort into weighted holdings; reveal the two-jobs card only after the concentration claim is spoken.
composition_groups.exit: Keep the container, then allow shared weather to appear on the causal-exposure turn.
composition_groups.reuse_reason: Unique fair framing of the index mechanism.

composition_groups.entry: Cut to the shared-cause weather at the causal-exposure turn, never as a generic storm transition.
composition_groups.motion: Weather crosses several distinct company tiles at once while the transparent automatic allocator continues routing equal-looking cash streams; evidence card states the qualified limit.
composition_groups.exit: Push into the roster when ticker-count diversification is named.

composition_groups.entry: Open the roster only when ticker-count diversification is contrasted with shared causes.
composition_groups.motion: Individual tiles separate, then the same causal weather aligns them; use automatic allocation only for its explicitly described remaining role.
composition_groups.exit: Collapse the tile set into an illustrative compounding calculation.

composition_groups.entry: Open the calculation card only when the starting value, target, and time horizon are actually narrated.
composition_groups.motion: Use an on-card deterministic reveal for the conditional math; then build two neutral sleeves only after upside and defense become separate jobs.
composition_groups.exit: Separate the sleeves at the introduction of the two-sleeve framework.
composition_groups.reuse_reason: The card is claim-bound; the sleeves establish the next mechanism.

composition_groups.entry: Show only a neutral rebalanced framework; no holdings list, allocation percent, or recommendation language.
composition_groups.motion: Productive-upside and defensive sleeves slide to independent positions, then rebalance around a central goal marker with no numerical content.
composition_groups.exit: Reserve the center for the qualified comparison card.

composition_groups.entry: Let the deterministic performance/risk card become the center of gravity when the example is named.
composition_groups.motion: Reveal historical-return comparison, construction, drawdown, and research-burden limits in spoken order; return to the sleeves only on tracking error and effort cost.
composition_groups.exit: Move the card aside for counterarguments before returning to the thesis.
composition_groups.reuse_reason: Card is claim-bound; sleeves recur only for named framework costs.

composition_groups.entry: Lead with memory failure points, then isolate the concentrated-basket and long-tail countercases as spoken.
composition_groups.motion: Failure points surface one at a time; the roster returns only for the named equal-weight/long-tail counterargument and must not imply equivalence or a recommendation.
composition_groups.exit: Clear countercase elements before the bounded thesis restatement.

composition_groups.entry: Return to each world only at its named thesis clause: capacity, low-cost participation, then testable two-sleeve hypothesis.
composition_groups.motion: Use three clean causal callbacks separated by hard reframes; no montage and no claim of a model portfolio.
composition_groups.exit: Collapse the three worlds back into the original two-elevator diagnosis.

composition_groups.entry: Return under the elevators exactly on the spoken callback.
composition_groups.motion: Reveal who-pays, what-is-scarce, supply-response, and cash-flow-versus-resale questions one at a time; final frame holds the two distinct upside/defense jobs.
composition_groups.exit: End card after the final job distinction—not on a predicted market outcome.
